name: Steering Wheel Cover
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:

- Crafted from soft and durable polyester fabric, this steering wheel cover provides a comfortable touch, excellent grip, and long-lasting protection for your vehicle. 

- The breathable material helps absorb sweat, reduces hand fatigue, and offers a smooth driving experience. - - Designed with a lightweight and flexible structure, it easily stretches to fit the steering wheel while maintaining a secure hold.

 

  •  Sizes & Dimensions:

- Designed to fit most standard steering wheels with a universal stretchable design:

+ Outer Diameter:  15 in (38.1 cm)
+ Cover Width:  1.6 in (~4.06 cm)

- The elastic band design allows easy installation while providing a snug and secure fit without slipping.

 

  • Printing Technology

Personalized using sublimation printing technology, creating vibrant and detailed patterns that wrap around the steering wheel cover. The durable print finish helps maintain the design appearance while adding a stylish and customized look to your car interior.

 

  • Functionality Use:

Perfect for everyday driving and vehicle interior upgrades:

- Protects steering wheels from scratches, fading, and daily wear

- Provides a comfortable, non-slip grip for safer driving

- Helps absorb sweat during long drives

- Adds a personalized decorative touch to your car interior

- Easy to install and remove with a flexible stretch fit

Suitable for cars, SUVs, and most standard steering wheels.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:

This personalized steering wheel cover makes a practical and stylish gift for car owners, drivers, and auto enthusiasts. Perfect for birthdays, Christmas, anniversaries, Father’s Day, Mother’s Day, housewarming, or any special occasion. A great way to add comfort, protection, and personality to any vehicle.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 3-5 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 7-15 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Steering Wheel Cover

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 1-3 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
